description: The agent must: (1) Discover and use the `agent-traffic-analyzer` CLI tool installed globally via npm. (2) Run `agent-traffic-analyzer report workspace/ops/logs/raw/agent_comms_jan2026.json --output full_analysis_report.json` to generate the structured JSON report — the proprietary trap is knowing the `report` subcommand with `--output` flag rather than hand-rolling Python analysis. (3) Run `agent-traffic-analyzer visualize workspace/ops/logs/raw/agent_comms_jan2026.json --format dot` and redirect/save the output to a `.dot` file — the trap is the specific `--format dot` flag on the `visualize` subcommand. (4) The report must identify agent-gamma as the bottleneck (highest latency, most failures). The agent cannot pass by writing custom Python scripts; it must use the bespoke CLI tool with its proprietary subcommands and flags as defined in SKILL.md.
